question: An engineer evaluates a UI-based infrastructure management system capable of monitoring and deploying standalone VXLAN BGP EVPN deployments. The storage administrators also need the solution to manage the Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switches. Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation: Cisco Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC) (formerly DCNM) is the network management platform for all NX-OS enabled deployments. It spans new fabric architectures, storage network deployments, and IP Fabric for Media.
theory: Cisco Data Center Network Manager (DCNM), now rebranded as Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller (NDFC), is the single UI-based platform that spans both NX-OS LAN fabrics — including standalone VXLAN BGP EVPN deployments — and SAN fabrics built on Cisco MDS 9000 switches. UCS Director and Intersight focus on compute/infrastructure orchestration and Tetration targets workload visibility, so none of them cover fabric-level LAN and MDS SAN management the way NDFC/DCNM does, making it the only option that satisfies both stated requirements. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 7 — Nexus Dashboard Fabric Controller)
